column1: # stale-reusable-pins.tsv — pins of estate reusables that are KNOWN DEAD, and the pin to move to.
# reusable_path is `hyperpolymath/<repo>/.github/workflows/<file>` or `hyperpolymath/<repo>/.github/workflows/*` (every reusable of that repo).
# Consumed by scripts/fix-stale-reusable-pin.sh; mirrored by hypatia (pin denylist PIN-003) so detection and repair carry the same facts.
# Window A — standards main 2026-06-01..2026-06-24 (d73c93e0..49ed4715): rust-ci-reusable.yml pins dtolnay/rust-toolchain by SHA and passes
#   no toolchain: input, so every caller fails in its first step with "'toolchain' is a required input" (standards#439 fixed it; plasma-parser-writer#105).
# Window B — standards commits reachable from main, 2026-08-19..2026-10-19 (5b5dab9f..fae7f010, 545 commits): actions.lock carries action records whose ref is the bare commit SHA;
#   since ~2026-10-15 GitHub validates the CALLEE lock at the called SHA and rejects these ("invalid lockfile pin"), so every reusable of standards
#   at these commits dies at Set up job for every caller (hypatia#929, cicd-squabbler run 38846539059). 75bd5994 is the first clean commit.
# Generated 2026-10-19 from a first-parent walk of hyperpolymath/standards; regenerate when standards fixes or re-breaks a window.
